name: Primal Trust Academy (Regulate / Integrate / Liberate)
founders: Cathleen King, DPT ('Dr. Cat') - physical therapist (DPT 2003), former chronic illness patient
founded_year_range: 2018-2021. Technique developed 2017; 1:1 coaching and the Creating Calm course 2018; mentorship pilot 2020; Primal Trust Academy membership 2021; Level 1 Regulate 2022. Basis: company About-page timeline; earliest Wayback capture of primaltrust.org 2021-12-19 (redirect to drcathleenking.wixsite.com), standalone site from May 2022.
cost_summary: Subscription: USD 96/month, USD 510 per 6 months, or USD 960/year (Oct 2026; extra cart discounts of 20-40% advertised). All levels included. FAQ says Level 1 can be completed for under USD 192. 1:1 mentors cost extra (price not published on membership, FAQ, About or Discovery Call pages). Limited financial assistance after 1 month of membership. Free e-book and webinars serve as the funnel. Typical figure = 6 months at the monthly rate.
mechanisms: autonomic/nervous system dysregulation (sympathetic overdrive, "stuck in fight-or-flight")
limbic system impairment / amygdala threat conditioning
mechanism_summary: Chronic symptoms are attributed to a dysregulated nervous system locked in a survival state. Chemical, pathogenic, physical and emotional triggers keep it there. A conditioned limbic/amygdala threat response (top-down) combines with polyvagal sympathetic or dorsal states (bottom-up) and developmental trauma and attachment wounds. Naviaux's cell danger response is invoked to link that state to fatigue, sensitivities and immune symptoms. Recovery is said to come from neuroplastic rewiring, vagal "safety" and memory reconsolidation.
techniques: vagus nerve toning (breath, humming, eye exercises)
parts work and attachment repair (Adult Main Personality)
near-daily live classes (somatics, sound healing, journaling, Q&A)
mainstream_notes: No guideline, hospital or payer adoption found. Visibility comes through integrative and Lyme/mould-community venues (King spoke at the Tick-Borne Illness Global Summit, Oct 2026, and other online summits 2022-2024), site testimonials from integrative clinicians (e.g., Neil Nathan MD, Will Cole), the Omega Institute retreat (2024), podcasts and patient forums. The Press page lists podcasts and summits only, no mainstream news coverage.
insurance_notes: Self-pay subscription. No insurance or HSA mention, and no clinician-billed delivery. FAQ says staff are not medical professionals and the company is 'not a medical establishment'.
controversy: No peer-reviewed data and no ClinicalTrials.gov registration. Self-reported internal "improvement" percentages (FAQ: 87% low-function at 3 months, 60% at 6 months, 51% Lyme, about 40% long COVID/CFS/mould) are given without methods, and the site's "Sources / Read the studies" section lists no studies. It relies on contested polyvagal theory and a speculative cell danger response extension. A single mechanism is claimed for a very broad set of conditions, including autoimmune disease, infections and EHS. ME/CFS advocates raise the usual limbic-retraining criticisms: blaming non-responders, risk of over-exertion, testimonial marketing. Trauma work is delivered by non-clinician mentors, and the recurring-subscription model sits alongside a 6-12-month healing horizon. Company reach figures are internally inconsistent.

popularity.reach_estimate: About 10,000-25,000 paying members cumulatively (company claims range from 7,000 to 13,500+ for Level 1 and 20,000+ 'lives changed', plus 1,000+ earlier Creating Calm users), with a larger free-content audience through webinars, summits and the e-book. Central estimate about 15,000-20,000.
popularity.method_notes: Reddit's JSON API blocked automated access and Google Trends wasn't accessible, so subreddit and search-trend metrics were not collected. Web search found only scattered Reddit mentions (e.g., one r/LongHaulersRecovery recovery post). YouTube (21.2K subscribers) is the main independent metric. The trajectory is built from the company's own dated timeline (2017 technique, 2018 coaching and Creating Calm, 2020 pilot, 2021 membership, 2022 Regulate, 2023 8,000 served, 2024 book/retreat/international expansion, Feb 2026 Daily Regulate, 2026 13,000-20,000+ claimed), plus Wayback captures (Dec 2021 redirect, May 2022 standalone site). The long-COVID-driven growth in 2021-22 is inferred. Company counts are inconsistent (7,000 / 8,000 / 10,000 / 13,000 / 13,500 / 20,000), so the reach figure is order-of-magnitude only.
